headline: Oil and gas inventories. So the government wants to tighten the system
summary: Poland's government adopted a draft amendment to the oil and gas reserves law. It aims to tighten the reserve system and improve management of emergency stocks, the Energy Ministry said.
why: Strategic oil and gas stockpile rules shape supply security and fuel-market resilience, which affect energy companies and consumers.
original_headline: Zapasy ropy i gazu. Tak rząd chce uszczelnić system
